doc: Streams a voice's PCM sample data to the SPU in <=0x400-word chunks. Validates the voice index (0-9) and its D_800799C0 size entry via func_8005D9DC (returns -1 if either check fails). Computes an SPU address/size pair from D_800799C0[voice] shifted by the global D_80079980[0] pitch/shift amount (voice 0 uses fixed constants 0x10/0xFFF0 instead of the table). Temporarily clears the D_80079974 busy flag (restoring it afterward) and snapshots+clears a pending D_80079990 request (restoring it afterward) while the transfer runs. Loops issuing func_8005D1D0 mode-2 (set address), mode-1 (start), and mode-3 (upload chunk) calls, waiting on a D_800794EC-identified event each iteration until all data is sent. Returns 0 on success, -1 on invalid voice/size.

globals.name: D_800799C0
globals.decl: typedef struct { s32 value[10]; } S_800799C0; extern S_800799C0 D_800799C0; /* plain s32 array, indexed [0..9] by voice/channel id; confirmed by sibling func_8005DA88 (indexed) and func_8005CA90 (index 0 direct) */

globals.name: D_80079974
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80079974[3]; /* plain s32 scalar flag at element [0]; array-of-3 padding only exists to force %hi/%lo (not gp_rel) codegen -- true size is 4 bytes. Siblings func_8005D460 (read), func_8005CC04/func_8005CA90 (write 0) all treat it as a bare scalar, no other fields observed. NOTE: this function's stores are written through the neighbouring symbol D_80079970[1] (same byte address, offset+4) purely to defeat gcc's address-CSE that would otherwise reuse the read's base register across the conditional store -- retail's asm shows independent %hi/%lo materializations for the read vs. each store of the SAME address, which only a syntactically different base symbol can reproduce. Reconciling code should keep D_80079974 itself as the plain-scalar canonical declaration; the D_80079970 alias is a local codegen trick, not evidence of an actual larger struct.

calls: func_8005D9DC(s32 a0) -> s32 : validates a channel/voice's size value; called with a0=D_800799C0[voice].

func_8005D1D0(s32 mode, ...) -> s32 : K&R/non-prototyped variadic-looking SPU voice-control dispatcher; called here with (2, address), (1), and (3, sampleAddr, size) -- arg count varies by mode so it must be declared with empty parens (no prototype) so each call site only sets up the registers it uses.
WaitEvent(s32 eventId) -> s32 : blocks until the given event fires; called with D_800794EC[0].
